description: Five offsets, each adding a fixed voltage or a whole number of semitones to a signal, or standing on its own as a voltage source

params.text: Sets the offset added on that row: -10V to 10V with the switch on VOLTS, or a whole number of semitones out to three octaves either way with it on SEMI
Switches every offset between volts, reaching -10V to 10V, and whole semitones, reaching three octaves either way

inputs.text: The signal that row's offset is added to; leave it unpatched and the row takes its signal from the nearest patched input above it

outputs.text: That row's signal with that row's offset added; with nothing patched into that row or any row above it, the offset alone

notes: the lamp beside an output is coloured to match the input whose signal that row is carrying
